# Cabinet history and evidence audit

This reference documents the **current frozen coding** from 1 January 2015 through 19 March 2026 (exclusive cutoff: 20 March). It reads accepted normalized records and the deterministic historical chronology; it does not reproduce research investigations or revise their decisions. The companion [narrative](CABINET_HISTORY_NARRATIVE.md) explains the consequential episodes in prose.

**Navigate:** [Dilma II](#audit-dilma_2) · [Temer](#audit-temer) · [Bolsonaro](#audit-bolsonaro) · [Lula III](#audit-lula_3) · [Uncertainty](#audit-uncertainty) · [Issues](#audit-issues) · [Evidence](#audit-evidence) · [Decisions](#audit-decisions).

## Reading the audit

Service and formal personal affiliation are separate. The cabinet set is the union of represented stable party identities among qualifying officeholders, displayed with the label in effect on each date. Intervals are half-open and dates follow the project’s daily closing-state convention. `UNKNOWN` is never a synonym for `UNAFFILIATED`. `primary_adjudicated` and `primary_provisional` are the builder’s actual composition statuses; a provisional set assumes no additional party contribution on explicitly documented dates while the historical affiliation remains UNKNOWN.

A period can contain both adjudicated and provisional days. Entries below use the daily status at the boundary, with assumptions linked separately. `adjudicated_source_boundary`, `adjudicated_continuity`, and similar stored statuses are shown verbatim; they must not be read as a blanket claim of exact registry dates. A bounded-date entry gives the inclusive earliest/latest admissible event dates and the selected primary date. The uncertainty interval itself ends exclusively at the latest date, when the after-state is fixed. The cutoff is observation clipping, never a dismissal. A stored date status can characterize an entire service or affiliation record; the linked constraints, rather than that label alone, define its exact bounded window.

The aggregate entries are exhaustive for the existing historical `transitions.csv`: **54 boundaries**, comprising 53 identity-set changes (including three administration boundaries) and one displayed-label change. The subordinate individual register contains **602 person/date events**. These combine coincident service and affiliation records without treating every clipped affiliation spell as a new joining or leaving event. A single party-set transition may have several changed-party witnesses. A coincident personnel event is not necessarily a cause.

### Event typology

| Layer | Event types and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Individual | Qualifying service begins/ends; continuing person changes office/service record; vacancy officeholder transition; actual personal party switch or transition to/from UNAFFILIATED; unresolved affiliation boundary; adjacent personal affiliation changes outside service (with no party contribution). Opening/admin endpoints are identified separately. Service entry/exit does not itself date personal affiliation entry/exit. |
| Organization | Dated rename, merger, or incorporation. A rename preserves identity; only continuing predecessor affiliations transfer in a merger/incorporation. |
| Office scope | Dated qualifying-office scope begins/ends; explicit vacancy begins/ends. Legal creation/abolition/reorganization is asserted only to the extent of the stored scope evidence. |
| Uncertainty | Start/end of a residual personal uncertainty interval or bounded date window; these are scope markers, not additional observed historical acts. |
| Primary assumption | Start/end of a documented PROVISIONAL_MODEL_ASSUMPTION, with historical UNKNOWN preserved. |
| Aggregate | Party entry/exit, administration boundary, or historical displayed-label change in the complete union. Four administration opening states are separately retained. |

Each evidence link opens a catalog record with a recognizable source description, stored assertion, access status, original locator and retained local paths where available. The catalog distinguishes a retained assertion ledger from an archived original. Decisions expose their stored rationale and alternatives. Broad continuity/scope decisions link their wider evidence once; that evidence is not automatically independent support for every individual claim. Machine detail is generated at `build/history_audit/cabinet_history_events.csv`, with source descriptions, source/decision closure and uncertainty IDs.

## Dilma II

<a id="event-opening-dilma_2"></a>
**Opening, 2015-01-01:** PCdoB, PDT, PMDB, PP, PR, PRB, PROS, PSD, PT, PTB. Daily coding status: `primary_adjudicated`. Opening roster and evidence are in the individual register and machine event `opening-dilma_2`.

<a id="event-transition-2015-03-19"></a>
### 2015-03-19

**Change:** Enters: none; leaves: PROS.

**Before:** PCdoB, PDT, PMDB, PP, PR, PRB, PROS, PSD, PT, PTB.

**After:** PCdoB, PDT, PMDB, PP, PR, PRB, PSD, PT, PTB.

**Mechanism and changed-party witnesses:**

- Cid Gomes: PROS → OUTSIDE_QUALIFYING_SERVICE. Service: Ministério da Educação (titular) → NO_QUALIFYING_SERVICE. Office succession: Cid Gomes → Luiz Cláudio Costa (Ministério da Educação). [person-2015-03-19-4f80df2dc0c0](#event-person-2015-03-19-4f80df2dc0c0)

**Date status:** `adjudicated_continuity;adjudicated_effective_publication`. The heading is the current coded boundary under the interval convention.

**Composition:** `primary_adjudicated` → `primary_adjudicated`; comparison `primary_sets_comparable`. **Retained uncertainty:** `no_linked_residual_uncertainty`.

**Selected stored assertions (including any retained conflicting accounts):** [LEG-8702e7355c32](#evidence-leg-8702e7355c32) — not_normalized_in_prior_ledger: DIAP January 2015 ministerial directory explicitly reports individual party affiliation..

**Decision orientation:** [R01](#decision-r01) — PROS supported. Daily-close service through March 18, publication-effective end March 19; no election outcomes consulted. The linked record preserves the full rationale and alternatives; current normalized records determine the coded state.

Evidence: [LEG-71604753d832](#evidence-leg-71604753d832), [LEG-8702e7355c32](#evidence-leg-8702e7355c32), [NEW-COSTA](#evidence-new-costa). Decisions: [PERSON-CONTINUITY-REVIEW](#decision-person-continuity-review), [POPULATION-REVIEW](#decision-population-review), [R01](#decision-r01).

## Bolsonaro

<a id="event-opening-bolsonaro"></a>
**Opening, 2019-01-01:** DEM, MDB, NOVO, PP, PSL. Daily coding status: `primary_adjudicated`. Opening roster and evidence are in the individual register and machine event `opening-bolsonaro`.

<a id="event-transition-2019-01-01"></a>
### 2019-01-01

**Change:** Administration changes. Enters: DEM, NOVO, PSL; leaves: PSD, PSDB, PV, PRB [identity REPUBLICANOS].

**Before:** MDB, PP, PRB, PSD, PSDB, PV.

**After:** DEM, MDB, NOVO, PP, PSL.

**Mechanism and changed-party witnesses:**

- Aloysio Nunes: PSDB → OUTSIDE_QUALIFYING_SERVICE. Service: Relações Exteriores (titular) → NO_QUALIFYING_SERVICE. [person-2019-01-01-2d32c1914c3a](#event-person-2019-01-01-2d32c1914c3a)

**Selected stored assertions (including any retained conflicting accounts):** [AFF-012](#evidence-aff-012) — Poder360: Reports both ministers signed PL affiliation that Sunday; Roma left Republicanos.; [AFF-020](#evidence-aff-020) — Partido Novo: Party note identifies him among its affiliates and says the rule for newly appointed officials was not retroactive.; [AFF-021](#evidence-aff-021) — Correio Braziliense: Reproduces party note that Ethics Commission suspended affiliation pending final decision, citing statute articles.; [AFF-023](#evidence-aff-023) — iG / interview with João Amoêdo: Party president describes suspension of affiliation with ethics investigation ongoing..

**Decision orientation:** [BOL-A01](#decision-bol-a01) — Douranews directly reports completed membership byMarch4 and separates later ceremony; contemporary March31 report explicitly confirms ceremony remained unheld. Give actual-status report priority over future ceremony plans. Choose latest March4 within documented March change bound beginningMarch1. Pontes provides União untilMarch27 and Ciro PP, so this bounded personal event should be aggregate-masked where those witnesses exist. The linked record preserves the full rationale and alternatives; current normalized records determine the coded state.

**Decision orientation:** [C061](#decision-c061) — Retain the reasoned primary continuity from explicit 2017 personal DEM membership, corroborated by a historical 2024 study explicitly labelling his ministerial service DEM. Atlas sfp and Spanish/German historical unaffiliated labels remain credible contrary assertions without a known personal departure date. Retain UNAFFILIATED as an alternative for the entire 2022 service. The alternative removes UNIAO because other witnesses had left; the minister cannot mask his own uncertainty. The linked record preserves the full rationale and alternatives; current normalized records determine the coded state.

### Helder Melillo Lopes Cunha Silva: 2022-12-30–2023-01-01 exclusive

**Record:** `affiliation-C044-helder-melillo-lopes-cunha-silva-2022-12-30@service-C044-helder-melillo-lopes-cunha-silva`. **Primary personal state:** `PARTY` (NOVO). **Alternatives:** `["NOVO","UNAFFILIATED"]`. **Scope:** `service_affiliation_intersection`. **Aggregate effect:** `primary_adjudication_with_set_changing_alternative`.

Official TSE public client resolves cdMotivoDesfiliacao=2 as A pedido do eleitor, distinct from Expulsao=1 and Judicial=10. The same record-detail template binds the reason field through that enum and separately displays dtDesfiliacao and tsCadastroDesfiliacao. The party departure form sends its chosen date as dtDesfiliacao and warns that reason-2 departure is effectuated after elector notice to the electoral court. Thus a bare populated dtDesfiliacao does not by itself prove completed judicial termination. Retain the exact-identity NOVO entry 2017-10-28, dtDesfiliacao 2021-02-03, REGULAR status 1, pending marker 1, null cancellation/exclusion and null tsCadastroDesfiliacao. The decoded reason is a recorded request category, not independent proof of the signed request or court receipt. Historical migration and actual court-notice date remain unverified; primary NOVO and the credible UNAFFILIATED alternative both remain for December 30-31 2022. C071 is retained as the earlier research state, superseded here only on the decoded code and directly observed client field mapping.

Potentially set-changing days: 2; composition-neutral days: 0; historical unidentified days caused: 0.

<a id="evidence-c067"></a>
### C067 — Agencia Estado/Folha de Londrina; Mauricio Correa, Paranoa Energia; Senado Federal

**Stored assertion:** Paulo Pedrosa: documented earlier personal PSDB membership and retrospective nonpartisan ministry description bound the credible affiliation alternatives; exact personal status remains unresolved

**Source/access:** `indexed_source_text;direct_open_failed_for_some_pages`. **Publication:** 1997-11-22;2018-02-21;2019-01-22;2019-11-14;2001-05-02. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** Preserve unresolved personal status between PSDB and UNAFFILIATED, rather than claim an exact departure date. Agencia Estado on November 22 1997 identifies Pedrosa as national PSDB executive secretary; contemporaneous February 21 2018 specialist reporting explicitly describes him as a former card-carrying tucano, connecting the same person to his subsequent Aneel and MME career. The January 22 2019 profile connects his departure from party politics before Aneel to his 2016-18 ministry service; November 14 2019 reporting retrospectively describes the ministry executive team under his command as apartidarios. The latter collective description is weaker than a personal affiliation certificate and does not establish the date of formal departure. These sources nevertheless bound the supported alternatives to continued PSDB affiliation or non-affiliation during the six service spells. Targeted searches for a new affiliation, departure or denial found no specific other-party event; PCdoB results concern a different cultural official. The alternatives are a documented historical adjudication, not a proof of every imaginable affiliation. Other qualifying ministers must independently represent PSDB throughout each spell before the builder can establish the aggregate; the personal record remains UNKNOWN. Formal vacancy service under C041 remains included, with no invented continuity of the departed titular.

### C072 — Exame; Reuters; FUNAG

**Stored assertion:** Carlos França directing MRE by March31 2021; restrict Brandelli vacancy service to March30

**Source/access:** `retrieved_source_text`. **Publication:** 2021-03-31;2021-11-19. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** Adjudicate effective service by March31 from contemporaneous observed ministry direction: Exame March31 reports that França had already redirected ministry cadres; Reuters March31 confirms his selection of the secretary-general directly with the selected diplomat. These support actual direction after published appointment, beyond nomination alone. FUNAG separately dates nomination March31 and its responsibility roll uses the signed decree date March29; neither date is mislabeled an exact possession observation. Retain the April6 public possession and legacy start as a contrary administrative-date assertion, not proof that ministry direction remained vacant until then. Choose March31, the latest date established by the earlier management observations, with March30–31 residual effective-entry bounds. Retain Brandelli as the designated vacancy replacement on March30; no new evidence establishes his personal affiliation. The explicit historical unaffiliated classification of França’s ministerial service continues to apply to that service when its effective start is corrected; no affiliation switch is invented.

<a id="evidence-c075"></a>
### C075 — Filiaweb historical TSE compilation; Ministerio do Turismo; Diario Oficial do Para

**Stored assertion:** Ana Carla Machado Lopes: historical PSDB entry2013-10-02 observed2016-07-27, with contextual identity linkage and documented forward continuity

**Source/access:** `scoped_historical_source_row_and_official_contextual_identity_adjudication`. **Publication:** 2016-07-27. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** The explicitly dated July27 2016 Filiaweb historical copy of TSE records lists the exact rare full name Ana Carla Machado Lopes in PSDB at Belem/PA, with entry October2 2013. Identity is adjudicated from full name, Para legal/professional history in the official MTur curriculum, and the official2019 ALEPA roster naming the same person as PSDB leadership chief of staff. The employment is an identity corroborator, not the membership evidence: the historical affiliation row supplies that fact. Apply the declared forward-continuity rule from the positive dated membership through her independently documented vacancy services. Targeted searches found no specific subsequent personal resignation, expulsion, new affiliation or general non-affiliation statement. The2025 statement that she was not affiliated to Uniao is consistent with PSDB and does not imply no party. Current TSE municipal-list non-matches do not establish a departure. This is a historical observation plus continuity and contextual identity adjudication, not a current certificate or an exact identifier match; source age and its own update warning remain explicit. Do not invent a non-affiliation alternative merely from absent current data. The five office interruptions do not create five personal affiliation events; one continuous affiliation spell supports the five service spells. Sabino return-date alternatives remain separately set-changing for PSDB representation.

<a id="evidence-v5w2e003"></a>
### V5W2E003 — Diario Oficial da Uniao (original PDF preserved by Poder360); Presidencia; ANTT legal-library index

**Stored assertion:** Original January1 2019 DOU fixes Sobral executive-secretary dismissal effective Jan1; Decree8851 supplies statutory ministerial-vacancy substitution

**Source/access:** `original_dou_pdf_rendered_and_official_statutory_text_reviewed`. **Publication:** 2016-09-21;2018-12-31;2019-01-01. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** Retain the December31 2018 statutory vacancy succession. The original January1 2019 DOU page1 explicitly dismisses Carlos Henrique Menezes Sobral as executive secretary effective January1. Decree8851/2016 article1 III supplies executive-secretary substitution during vacancy unless a specific presidential designation exists. With C034 Marun publication-date departure and the named continuing deputy, this supports the existing one-day adjudication. No vacancy-specific Sobral decree is claimed; no competing designation or earlier departure was established. No change to routine-leave/signature-only rule or half-open dates. ANTT index records Marun dismissal among December31 publications; exact linked act returned invalid-URL page and is not described as retrieved original.

**Original/stored locator:** `https://static.poder360.com.br/2019/01/Diario-Oficial-1jan2019.pdf;https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2016/decreto/d8851.htm;https://anttlegis.datalegis.inf.br/action/ActionDatalegis.php?acao=abrirResenhaAnoData&ano=2018&cod_menu=7739&cod_modulo=422`.

### V5W4E003 — Terracap committee document in third-party mirror; official archive inaccessible

**Stored assertion:** A publicly readable mirror of Terracap eligibility minute dated 2019-10-16 names Jonathas and a standard eligibility declaration with unspecified negative TSE certificates. It does not reproduce a negative party-affiliation certificate or declare his party state; original archive returned 403.

**Source/access:** `retrieved_source_mirror_original_unavailable`. **Publication:** 2019-10-16. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** V5 new pre-service personnel channel: public mirror of Terracap eligibility minute dated2019-10-16 names Jonathas and case00111-00010585/2019-82, declaration and unspecified negative certificates including TSE. Neither the certificate type nor an explicit affiliation statement is reproduced. Header says19th meeting while footer says17th; original Terracap archive returns403. This is a source-discovery/limitation record, not a verified original or proof of nonaffiliation. W5 independently reviewed the 2022 Petrobras issuer filing; independence/PEP declarations likewise do not establish the March2021 personal party state.

<a id="evidence-v5w5e001"></a>
### V5W5E001 — Tribunal Superior Eleitoral

**Stored assertion:** Official TSE client decodes Helder departure reason 2 and directly maps date fields; effective historical departure remains uncertain

**Source/access:** `official_public_client_source_retrieved_and_schema_traced`. **Publication:** not recorded. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** Official TSE public client resolves cdMotivoDesfiliacao=2 as A pedido do eleitor, distinct from Expulsao=1 and Judicial=10. The same record-detail template binds the reason field through that enum and separately displays dtDesfiliacao and tsCadastroDesfiliacao. The party departure form sends its chosen date as dtDesfiliacao and warns that reason-2 departure is effectuated after elector notice to the electoral court. Thus a bare populated dtDesfiliacao does not by itself prove completed judicial termination. Retain the exact-identity NOVO entry 2017-10-28, dtDesfiliacao 2021-02-03, REGULAR status 1, pending marker 1, null cancellation/exclusion and null tsCadastroDesfiliacao. The decoded reason is a recorded request category, not independent proof of the signed request or court receipt. Historical migration and actual court-notice date remain unverified; primary NOVO and the credible UNAFFILIATED alternative both remain for December 30-31 2022. C071 is retained as the earlier research state, superseded here only on the decoded code and directly observed client field mapping.

**Original/stored locator:** `https://filia2-externo.tse.jus.br/main.655678f4759dcc30.js;https://filia2-externo.tse.jus.br/672.9e4193a1e7e92416.js;https://filia2-externo.tse.jus.br/927.95ca5669143d8c8c.js;https://www.tse.jus.br/legislacao/compilada/res/2019/resolucao-no-23-596-de-20-de-agosto-de-2019`.

<a id="evidence-v5w5e002"></a>
### V5W5E002 — Ministerio das Comunicacoes; Presidencia; CGI.br official order repository

**Stored assertion:** Maria Estella served as designated substitute in the Communications vacancy, not titular

**Source/access:** `official_roll_and_order_retrieved_decree_web_text`. **Publication:** 2023-01-02;2016-09-21;2023-01-03. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** Official MCom 2022 responsibility roll, updated January 2 2023, dates Fabio Faria dismissal December 21 2022 and lists Maria Estella Dantas Antonichelli as the continuing executive secretary. Decree 8851/2016 article 1 III supplies the executive-secretary substitute during vacancy, absent a specific presidential designation. The December 21 2022 interministerial order 6672, published January 3 2023, identifies Estella as Ministra de Estado das Comunicacoes Substituta; C028 independently records her December 30 substitute signature. Correct inherited capacity titular to vacancy_acting without changing the service interval [2022-12-21,2023-01-01). The January publication date of order 6672 is not an extension of ministerial service.

**Original/stored locator:** `https://www.gov.br/mcom/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/transparencia-e-prestacao-de-contas/rol-de-responsaveis-1/2022;https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2016/decreto/d8851.htm;https://cgi.br/portarias/ano_numero/2022/6672/`.

### V5W5E003 — Telebras

**Stored assertion:** Maria Estella Telebras eligibility declarations do not supply personal party state

**Source/access:** `retained_original_nominee_dossier_and_committee_minutes_reviewed`. **Publication:** 2022-04. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

**Stored evidence rationale:** Telebras 57th eligibility committee minutes of February 11 2022 review her Form C signed December 14 2021 and state that requirements/impediments were answered yes/no. Those are fiscal-council eligibility assertions, not an explicit personal non-affiliation declaration. The original proposal and 283rd board assessment address credentials and eligibility. ### V5W7E003 — Secretaria de Comunicacao Social / Agencia Gov-EBC

**Stored assertion:** Official post-event Secom/EBC report confirms actual ministerial exercise by Sabino on the morning of 2025-11-17.

**Source/access:** `official_full_web_extraction_retained_direct_fetch_unavailable`. **Publication:** 2025-11-17. **Retrieval:** 2026-09-10.

This independently establishes actual ministerial exercise by November17, before the evening parliamentary notification. It establishes an upper bound, not his first moment back. ## Reproduction and scope

Run `python3 -B scripts/build_history_audit.py --historical build/stage10-final/historical` from the producer root after a current deterministic historical build exists. The script checks normalized copies semantically, writes the machine event view before this reference document, and leaves ignored outputs under `build/history_audit/`. It neither invokes research nor changes construction inputs. The narrative remains separately edited prose. `--check` checks the saved event/aggregate correspondence and citation/link references without rewriting documents. See [CODEBOOK.md](../CODEBOOK.md) and [CONTRACT.md](../CONTRACT.md) for authoritative semantics.
